signature: SUBROUTINE ZGBBRD( VECT, M, N, NCC, KL, KU, AB, LDAB, D, E, Q,

params.name: vect
M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ncc
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix C. $\mathrm{NCC} \ge 0$.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals of the matrix A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: On entry, the m-by-n band matrix A, stored in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: `AB(ku+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{ku}) \le i \le \min (m,j+\mathrm{kl})$. On exit, A is overwritten by values generated during the reduction.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The diagonal elements of the bidiagonal matrix B.

params.name: e
params.reference: The superdiagonal elements of the bidiagonal matrix B.

params.name: Q
params.reference: If `VECT = 'Q'` or 'B', the m-by-m unitary matrix Q. If `VECT = 'N'` or 'P', the array Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge \max (1,M)$ if `VECT = 'Q'` or 'B'; $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: PT
params.reference: If `VECT = 'P'` or 'B', the n-by-n unitary matrix P'. If `VECT = 'N'` or 'Q', the array `PT` is not referenced.

params.name: ldpt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `PT`. $\mathrm{LDPT} \ge \max (1,N)$ if `VECT = 'P'` or 'B'; $\mathrm{LDPT} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, an m-by-ncc matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by $Q^H \, C$. C is not referenced if `NCC = 0`.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$ if $\mathrm{NCC} > 0$; $\mathrm{LDC} \ge 1$ if `NCC = 0`.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
